data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €793
data.summary: The Finanzamt Musterhafen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 21 May 2026. It results in a refund of €793.00, which will be paid out to the known bank account.
data.explanation: Your 2025 tax return has been processed. Income tax of €4,402.00 was set, but your employer already withheld €5,195.00 in wage tax, so you get €793.00 back. The money should be paid to your known bank account in the next few days. If you think the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or state it in person at the office; the app shows the deadline. Check the figures against your return. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final.
data.tax_note: This is your income tax assessment for 2025; keep it with your tax records.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) if you disagree
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt Musterhafen, or declare it in person on record.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Musterhafen, Kaistraße 1, 27568 Musterhafen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
